topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: I should have said something when I heard the whispers, the plans. It’s not like I didn’t know the boardroom buzzing meant something was shifting. But I stayed silent, thinking my quiet support would be enough. Now, the office feels different, lighter, but not in a good way. I keep catching myself glancing at the empty desk, expecting to see them there, head down, focused. Their chair is still, now, and I can’t shake the memory of our last conversation, the one where I hesitated to fully speak my thoughts. Days pass, and the silence grows louder. I wonder if things might have been different if I’d just spoken up, if I’d shown them they weren’t alone in the face of change.
